fixes.issue: MAJOR (a false claim of the formalizer, recorded in SCOPE, two docstrings and REPORT question 1)
fixes.fix: The claim « σ is not determined by f when equal-dimensional factors are single points » was FALSE: f conjugates [c] to [c∘σ] (smul_torus) and the torus acts freely (eq_one_of_piTorusAut_smul_eq), so σ is unique for any nonempty factors. It was the formalizer's error, caught by the audit and corrected; it is NOT a paper finding (nothing printed is affected). IsCompatibleAssocPi.perm_unique is now the auditor's perm_unique_of_nonempty (/tmp/bzaud45xy/perm.lean) under [∀ i, Nonempty (B i)]; compatiblePerm and ker_compatiblePerm are restated under [∀ i, Nonempty (B i)] instead of [∀ i, Nontrivial (B i)] (they now cover connected 0-dimensional factors); the false sentences are deleted from SCOPE, the module docstring and both docstrings; REPORT question 1 is WITHDRAWN

fixes.fix: Proved: castRnO / IsConeIso.exists_smul_eq (a conical iso read in charts after identifying the dimensions), piBlockPerm / piPermGU (the block permutation ⟨i, a⟩ ↦ ⟨σ i, a⟩ of ℝ^{Σ(nᵢ+1)}, in GU by abs_det_funCongrLeft), piBlockPt_perm, isGXMorphism_piPermMap (the permuted map (mᵢ) ↦ (φᵢ m_{σ(i)}) is a conical morphism of the product cone: piBlockGU g * piPermGU σ in product charts), bijective_piPermMap, and the existence lemma exists_isCompatibleAssocPi. Déf. 2's mark is kept and now earned in full
